sql: SELECT "scanmesh"."facetregistry" AS k, (CAST("scanmesh"."geomdeltamm" AS REAL) / "scanmesh"."facetresmm") AS m1 FROM "scanmesh" WHERE (CAST("scanmesh"."geomdeltamm" AS REAL) / "scanmesh"."facetresmm") IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: scanmesh.geometric deviation relative to mesh vertex spacing
why: geometric deviation / mesh vertex spacing: a ratio of two quantities in mm
rank scanmesh rows by geometric deviation relative to mesh vertex spacing

sql: SELECT "scans"."questregistry" AS k, (CAST("scans"."gbsize" AS REAL) / "scans"."spanmin") AS m1 FROM "scans" WHERE (CAST("scans"."gbsize" AS REAL) / "scans"."spanmin") IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: scans.scan file size per scanning duration
why: scan file size / scanning duration: the catalogue declares scan file size a rate over scanning duration
rank scans rows by scan file size per scanning duration

sql: SELECT "scanprocessing"."flowregistry" AS k, ("scanprocessing"."memusagegb" - "scanprocessing"."remaingb") AS m1 FROM "scanprocessing" WHERE ("scanprocessing"."memusagegb" - "scanprocessing"."remaingb") IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: scanprocessing.RAM usage minus remaining storage space
why: RAM usage - remaining storage space: both in GB and of the same kind (stocks) on the same one processing workflow
rank scanprocessing rows by RAM usage minus remaining storage space

sql: SELECT "scanregistration"."logregistry" AS k, ("scanregistration"."errvalmm" - "scanregistration"."logaccumm") AS m1 FROM "scanregistration" WHERE ("scanregistration"."errvalmm" - "scanregistration"."logaccumm") IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
why: registration error - registration accuracy: both in mm and of the same kind (stocks) on the same one registration log
rank scanregistration rows by registration error minus registration accuracy

sql: SELECT "scanmesh"."facetregistry" AS k, ("scanmesh"."facetresmm" - "scanmesh"."geomdeltamm") AS m1 FROM "scanmesh" WHERE ("scanmesh"."facetresmm" - "scanmesh"."geomdeltamm") IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: scanmesh.mesh vertex spacing minus geometric deviation
why: mesh vertex spacing - geometric deviation: both in mm and of the same kind (stocks) on the same one mesh record
rank scanmesh rows by mesh vertex spacing minus geometric deviation
